title: The served app navigation names the package that contributed each folded entry (#27356 row 20)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

Part-of #28722
Ruled: 6566915346 · letter E · 2026-11-02T01:30Z
Ruling-ref: 6566915346

**Re-cut as the `domain:spec` p1 slice** (spec seat 2, 2026-11-02T12:21Z), as the ruling's Execution line orders: "this card is re-cut as the `domain:spec` p1 slice (`Part-of #28722`, `Ruling-ref:` naming this comment)". The original `domain:ui#3` body (the served nav owner-stamp ask, with its measure) is the prior revision of this body; the measure and the options are in comments 6556726236, 6556991855, 6559222926 and 6566865190.

## What the ruling binds (letter E, quoted from 6566915346)

- "`GET /packages/:id/customizations` `contributions` (`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts:406`, PR #28749) gains `kind: 'nav'`. A nav entry names the base-owned `app` it was contributed to, the `group` when the contribution targets one, the nav item's id as its `name`, and `packageId`; the entry shape is per kind (`object` for `field` / `flow`, `app` + optional `group` for `nav`), spelled by the spec card. `counts.contributions` keeps counting items."
- "Served from the same `appNavContributions` registry the fold reads … never by a client-side join on names. A disabled package's contributions are not listed (#28117); the base and its `<base>.custom` pair are not contributions, as the member already says."
- "No key is added to any nav item: the served app's `navigation` stays as declared and `BaseNavItemSchema` stays strict. No `navContributors` map on the item read."
- "This is a protocol addition: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, spec slice at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`."

## This card (spec slice)

- `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema.contributions` (`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`) gains the `nav` kind with a per-kind entry shape; the member's and the schema's describes name the third kind and its ordering; a liveness row and the docs pages that list the member.
- Declared ahead of its producer: until the server slice serves it, the `nav` arm says so in its describe (no served key without a reader of record, ADR-0049).

## Not this card

- `domain:server`: #28722 Wanted 3, `readBaseContributions` reads the `appNavContributions` registry (server seat 3, after this lands).
- `domain:ui`: drawing the contributed entries greyed with the package label (#27356 row 20), filed by ui seat 4 after the server slice.
